subject: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: clara.diaz@nutriworks.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline

Hi Clara —

Thanks for the heads-up about the org changes. Really glad to meet you (virtually) and we’re keen to get the evaluation back on track. To make this easy I’ve attached a fresh MAP template and put a short, suggested timeline below so we can align on owners and decision gates.

Suggested kickoff agenda (30 minutes):
- Intros + roles (5m)
- Success criteria for the POC (10m)
- Eval requirements: data access, test set, SLOs (10m)
- Next steps & target close (5m)

Suggested timeline (draft):
- Week 1: Kickoff + access setup (owner: NutriWorks — Clara / Redwood — Marissa)
- Week 2–3: POC tests (owner: Clara + Karhik for infra support)
- Week 4: Evaluation & decision window (stakeholder review + procurement)

Can you confirm the right stakeholders (tech lead, procurement, security) and a 30-minute slot this week? I’ve attached MAP_template_v3.pdf and will upload a tracker to the shared Drive once we lock stakeholders.

Attachment: MAP_template_v3.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — excited to partner again.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM serving
From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nutriworks.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@nutriworks.com, ethan.rhodes@nutriworks.com
Date: 2027-03-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the quick note and the template. I’m Clara (Director, Product at NutriWorks) — I’ve taken over as the internal champion while Ethan transitions to a new role; looping him in so there’s continuity. Procurement is cc’d.

High level: we still want to move forward but need to tighten the evaluation scope given resource constraints. Two immediate asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood confirm SOC 2 evidence (type and date)? Procurement will need that before any infra access.
2) For the POC, we’ll limit to a 4-week window and a smaller dataset (we’ll propose exact size once we sync).

I’m available for a kickoff tomorrow 11:00–11:30 PT or Thursday 09:00–09:30 PT. Either works for me — which is better for your team?

—
Clara Diaz
Director, Product — NutriWorks
clara.diaz@nutriworks.com
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: clara.diaz@nutriworks.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-12T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline

Clara — great to meet you. I’ve drafted a concrete MAP and uploaded it to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP_NutriWorks (link also in HubSpot). Key highlights:

- Decision criteria: accuracy within baseline +/-3%, median latency < 250ms on test queries; business acceptance by Product and Ops.
- Milestones: kickoff, access provisioning, POC execution (2 weeks), results review (1 week), procurement & PO (1 week).
- Owners: Clara (NutriWorks product lead), Ethan (technical reviewer), Marissa (RWI AE), Karthik (RWI SE).
- Risk: procurement docs are pending; recommend we start the questionnaire now.

I attached the spreadsheet tracker (mutual_action_plan_nutriworks.xlsx) — it has owners, dates, and a column for blockers. I’ll also paste a HubSpot deal link here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/NW-2027-0311-01

If the shortened scope looks good, I propose we treat the POC as a single feature validation (not full integration) to hit your timeline. Confirm kickoff slot and I’ll send the invite + Drive access.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_nutriworks.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 tabs)

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: clara.diaz@nutriworks.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-14T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline

Thanks all — quick technical notes ahead of kickoff:

1) Access: for the POC we prefer a read-only S3 bucket or a shared S3 presigned token. If you can’t share data, we can run a synthetic subset but results will vary.
2) Staging: we’ll spin up a small dedicated instance under Redwood Dedicated (short-term) to mirror your traffic profile; let us know if you have IP allowlists or VPC requirements.
3) Eval artifacts: please provide a representative test set (CSV) and a short list of 10 canonical prompts/endpoints you care about. Karthik can pair with Ethan for infra questions.

Below I’m quoting Marissa’s milestone list for clarity:
> - Kickoff, access provisioning, POC execution (2 weeks), results review (1 week), procurement & PO (1 week).

I’ll prepare a checklist to attach to the MAP with the infra steps and expected timing. Also, Laura — do we have the SOC2 summary doc I can send to procurement?

—
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@nutriworks.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@nutriworks.com
Date: 2027-03-15T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rebooting MAP with NutriWorks — new champion & updated timeline

Thanks — the proposed plan looks reasonable. A couple of adjustments from my side:

- Scope tweak: for speed we’ll constrain the POC to a single high-value flow (~50k tokens total) and evaluate two endpoints for latency/accuracy.
- Procurement: I attached the completed vendor questionnaire (procurement_questionnaire_filled.pdf) — procurement flagged SOC2 assertion and encryption-at-rest questions. They’ll want the SOC2 summary and cert date up front.
- Next steps: Marissa, please send calendar invite for tomorrow 11:00 PT and include the Drive link with the MAP tracker. Karithk, I’ll share a small CSV and the canonical prompts before EOD.

Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_filled.pdf (form)
